body: Okay, my theory that in directX12 CUSTOM3 just dont contain valid data, because if i replace CUSTOM3 with CUSTOM2 everything works well 0_o

I was unable to reproduce the bug in 4.7 dev 1 and 4.6 stable, but i was able to reproduce the crash in a dev build from latest master https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/74b5be24f405492e50403948045830d13472e01e (reverting an unrelated PR, as this MRP also trigger another bug in GDScript). Replacing CUSTOM3 with CUSTOM2 also stops the crash here.
